programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: 小男人阿寬與妻Ann復合後, 互相遷就, 再婚生活逐漸愜意。寬進公關公司任職, 認識了缺乏自信的女同事關之琳。見她終日冒冒失失, 更被追求不遂者捉挾, 寬於心不忍, 在工作上處處扶持。正因如此, 關對寬由同事之誼轉為男女之情, 剛好寬與Ann稍有磨擦, 寬轉而愛上了關, 更與關去日本公幹。此時, Ann遇上區議員朱君, 對朱頗有好感, 但Ann懸崖勒馬, 沒有動真情。返港後, 寬欲向Ann攤牌, 關竟搶著表示與寬只屬工作關係, 請Ann放心。關毅然斷絕與寬的感情關係, 令寬遭受打擊, 心情頹然。Ann得悉真相, 與寬決裂, 幾經糾纏、掙扎、衝突, 兩人竟又復合, 展開了另一段再婚又再婚的新婚生活。

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: 粵劇名伶冷劍心為了把粵劇現代化, 請來林導演加入百老匯元素, 受到保守派排斥。另一方面, 劍心的丈夫決定移民, 劍心和女兒珊珊反對, 而女兒又被懷疑有同性戀傾向, 家人關係更加惡化。此時劍心在廿二年前於南洋誕下的私生子竟然出現眼前, 還跟劇團新進花旦葉玉媚相戀......

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: 李阿擠是潮州大阿哥, 但他已經事業有成有妻有子, 開始討厭鎗林彈雨的生活；擠哥曾有兩名手下鄧家勇與陳定國, 定國是家勇父親吉叔養子, 二人本來情同手足, 但芋次事件中, 家勇與擠哥反目而定國隨即遠走馬六甲。擠哥與家勇大哥朱老大是生意上的拍擋, 朱老大以家勇逐漸失去控制, 想除去家勇卻反被家勇所殺。擠哥意圖與家勇和談反為所辱。家勇更進而調戲擠哥妻子, 定國得悉後從馬六甲趕回代擠哥向家勇求情, 家勇允之...

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: 大內密探龍龍九奉命追捕鬼王七盜, 發現他是武當掌門凌雲鶴之化身, 在途中結識劍神西門吹雪。西門吹雪救了葉子青而相戀, 劍聖葉孤城向西門吹雪挑戰, 於九月十五日紫禁之巔比劍, 爭奪世上劍法第一, 御妹金燕子傾慕葉孤城, 欲阻止是次比劍。當中龍龍九識破此乃是刺殺皇上之陰謀...

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: 四個高中畢業、熱愛音樂青年, 各為自己目標奮鬥的故事。阿駒是一個為移民而與家人瘋狂搵錢的青年, 最後儲錢目標達到, 但因體力透支而病倒；阿強是一個有衝勁而頗有頭腦的青年人, 立志要創一番事業, 可惜誤入一間金融公司工作, 在上司設計之下連番受挫折, 最後連至親亦受牽連；阿中自小立志加入紀律部隊服務大眾, 但因身體潺弱, 未獲警隊接納, 索性加入交通督導員行列, 但因職責特殊, 對內對外均受極大壓力而深感痛苦；阿榮是一個勤奮而內向的學生, 一心入讀大學音樂系, 但在女友之父親諸多阻撓之下, 終於選讀入醫科...

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: 葉孤紅做事頭頭碰著黑, 從小到大無人問津, 幸好孤紅個性開朗, 對一切噩運也一笑置之。孤紅將大部份時間寄託於各種風水, 卻無助於自己的霉運。在命運驅使上, 孤紅遇上著名風水術數家賴料布, 而這段姻緣還可化解孤紅一直以來厄運, 豈料橫裡殺出另一個堪輿高手斷蟹從中作梗...

programme.title: 問心 2 第23集

Réveillé de son sommeil par des membres de la tribu de l'eau, il découvre sa destinée : Aang est l'Avatar. programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Warriors' Dream! Luffy's Conquer of Udon!
programme.desc: The freed prisoners in Udon refuse to fight alongside Luffy because he is a pirate. Raizo and Old Man Hyo try their best to convince them, but an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners hope after taking down Kaido!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Orochi's Hunting Party! The Ninja Group vs. Zoro!
programme.desc: After standing against Orochi, Zoro and Hiyori are chased by Orochi's ninja group. Meanwhile, Orochi is told that they captured Trafalgar Law as the people of the Flower Capital prepare for the upcoming Fire Festival.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Tension Rises in Onigashima! Two Emperors of the Sea Meet?!
programme.desc: Nami and Franky join Kanjuro who has taken Yasuie's dead body to bury him with Oden, and together they hit the road. Robin, Usopp, and Brook are at the dock trying to figure out a way to pass through a check point.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Hiyori's Confession! A Reunion at Bandit's Bridge!
programme.desc: As the clash between Kaido and Big Mom continues, Queen looks for a way to get out of Onigashima. Meanwhile in Udon, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies, four bosses from each region.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Its Name is Enma! Oden's Great Swords!
programme.desc: Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took his Shusui and Kawamatsu shares with Hiyori his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. As they catch up to Zoro, they find a room filled with swords.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A New Alliance?! Kaido’s Army Gathers!
programme.desc: As the day of the raid approaches, Law finds someone who might help him escape the prison and Kin'emon gathers up most of his main allies to discuss the raid plan. Meanwhile, at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a stunning declaration!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
programme.desc: Kin'emon, Momonosuke, and the others can't fight back tears when they hear that Hiyori is alive. Zoro is stunned by Enma's demonic power and its ties to him.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Big News! An Incident That Will Affect the Seven Warlords!
programme.desc: The resolution that passed the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, a Navy captain Koby secretly contacts someone who is currently in the Land of Wano.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
programme.desc: Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance of the two Emperors of the Sea. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Navy soldiers about the legendary Rocks Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Rendezvous Port! The Land of Wano Act Three Begins!
programme.desc: On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi leaves the mainland of the Land of Wano heading for Onigashima where a big banquet will take place.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Number-One Samurai in the Land of Wano! Here comes Kozuki Oden!
programme.desc: The night before the great battle, Orochi orders the destruction of the Sunny along with some bridges across the country to block Akazaya samurai's allies from their rendezvous.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin'emon!
programme.desc: When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin'emon, Oden steps in. Kin'emon is impressed when he sees Oden's strength and pledges his life to serve him.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Changing Destiny! The Whitebeard Pirates Cast Ashore!
programme.desc: Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Whitebeard's Little Brother! Oden's Great Adventure!
programme.desc: Oden's journey finally begins. He is in awe of all the things that he has never seen before. And for the first time in his life, he becomes a wanted person and makes the headlines which catches the eye of a high-profile figure.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the Land of Wano, the Shogun Sukiyaki falls critically ill and names Orochi proxy Shogun until Oden returns in case he dies.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Roger is amazed when he finds out that Oden can read the script on the Ponegliff since he believes it will guide him to the last, undiscovered island where no man has ever been.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Singing out loud, the Roger Pirates continue on with their journey. They soar up to the island above the clouds and go down into the deep sea to get to the island at the sea bottom.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The King of the Pirates is Born! Arriving at the Last Island!
programme.desc: Oden and the Roger Pirates head for the Land of Wano to obtain a copy of the Road Ponegliff. Oden sees Kin'emon and the others for the first time in years, but he immediately returns to the sea leaving his wife and children behind.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
programme.desc: After reaching Laugh Tale, Roger declares the disbanding of his pirate group and disembarks first. Oden gets dropped off at the Land of Wano and reunites with his family and retainers.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sad News! The Opening of the Great Pirate Era!
programme.desc: Enraged by Orochi's tyrannical acts, Oden raids his castle in the Flower Capital and points his sword at Orochi. However, hours later, people who were waiting for Oden to come out after defeating Orochi see the unexpected.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Raid! Oden and the Akazaya Nine!
programme.desc: Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The End of the Battle! Oden vs. Kaido!
programme.desc: Kaido comes to the mainland along with his troops to fight against Oden and the Akazaya samurai who were on their way to raid Kaido's mansion. Even though Oden's group are unprepared and outnumbered, they fight hard to save the future of the Land of Wano.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Boiled to Death! Oden's One-hour Struggle!
programme.desc: Oden and the Akazaya members are sentenced to death by boiling in a pot. Oden asks for a chance to survive which is accepted by Kaido. Then, Oden enters the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head.

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: When a blackout plunges Gringey City into darkness, Ash and friends go to investigate the nearby power plant, where they find Magnemite and a host of Grimer. Could they be responsible for the city’s power outage?

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: Caught in a sudden rain shower, our heroes quickly try to seek some shelter. Dragging a very reluctant Misty, Ash, and Brock go inside a cabin, and instantly get the impression that they are not alone!

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: The gang discovers a large group of wild Pikachu, and though they first seem frightened by the intruder, the group eventually opens up to Ash’s Pikachu. How will Pikachu feel seeing others of its kind in the wild?

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: Ash and his friends find a large home with a lavish garden party in full swing, attended by the Trainers of Pokémon who evolve using Evolution stones. Maybe they can see the seemingly abandoned Eevee’s Trainer here?

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: Our hungry heroes arrive at a small village. In return for a meal, Ash, Misty, and Brock agree to investigate what is causing the river to dry up, destroying the village’s harvest.

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Naked Science
programme.desc: By far the largest planet, 1300 times the size of Earth, it’s a world so enormous it could swallow every planet and moon in the solar system and still have room to spare.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: why have alien civilizations not presented themselves?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: An advanced $900 million planetary explorer designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal intricate details undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: The night sky has always been a source of wonder and mystery. In the quest to explore the universe, our greatest ally is the Hubble telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Painted By Light
programme.desc: When the universe formed, all of space blazed white-hot, but it didn't last. Darkness reined for 200 million years before the light was reborn.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Colour
programme.desc: Color is essential to both art and astronomy. When measured, it can tell us the temperature, chemical composition, and motion of astronomical objects.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Perspective
programme.desc: For most of human history, the night sky seemed two-dimensional. To our ancestors, this perspective gave no hint to the universe's true depth.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Grand Design
programme.desc: The Hubble telescope finds design on a grand scale, especially when it zooms in on the spiral galaxies that populate the universe around us.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vanishing Points
programme.desc: The core of a galaxy attracts our eyes and makes up feel like we are gazing down a deep well. But this illusion conceals an even deeper truth.

programme.title: Family Guy

programme.title: Un passo dal cielo
programme.desc: Pietro è un ispettore forestale che vive a San Candido, in Südtirol, e, collaborando con il commissario di polizia Nappi, risolve delitti e misteri che avvengono tra le Alpi.

programme.title: Tutto può succedere
programme.desc: Quattro fratelli, Alessandro, Sara, Giulia e Carlo, sono accomunati dall'esperienza di essere o scoprirsi genitori. Con le proprie famiglie, essi devono affrontare le difficoltà e le sfide del nostro tempo.

programme.title: Una grande famiglia
programme.desc: Stefano frequenta Marta e lo confida a Scalese; Leonardo si deve trasferire a Roma ma Laura non vuole lasciare Inverigo. Raul trova al maneggio una prova che incastra Jamal e, suo malgrado, la consegna alla polizia.

programme.title: Raccontami
programme.desc: Un'eclissi di sole porta tutti a radunarsi sul terrazzo del condominio. Riappare intanto Caroline, mentre un giovane professore anticonformista pone ai suoi alunni domande complesse.

programme.title: Il commissario Montalbano

programme.title: Belcanto
programme.desc: Maria e le sue figlie, Antonia e Carolina, lasciano Napoli per sfuggire dal violento marito e inseguire il sogno del canto a Milano. Nel mondo dorato e spietato dell'Opera di metà 800, affrontano inganni, tradimenti e passioni travolgenti.

programme.title: La strada di casa
programme.desc: Fausto non crede che il figlio sia un assassino e si convince che la scomparsa di Irene sia legata a quella di un bambino ospite di una casa famiglia. Fausto scopre un sabotaggio. Gloria teme di essere affetta da Alzheimer.

programme.desc: Quando Enrico viene licenziato a causa dei suoi metodi poco ortodossi, Titti prende le sue difese. Carlo si autoproclama difensore di Persichetti, un compagno di classe affetto dai pidocchi.

programme.desc: Primo inverno di liberta nella rivoluzionaria Pietrogrado, sono passati sei mesi dalle cinque giornate di marzo che rovesciarono il regime zarista.

programme.desc: Storia in breve: il Santo sociale - San Giovanni Bosco, 'padre e maestro della gioventù'. Un approfondimento della sua rivoluzione sociale e cattolica nella seconda meta' dell'O - ttocento. -.

programme.title: Screenshot: Gli artisti e la loro storia
programme.desc: Cimabue, al secolo Cenni di Pepo, è uno dei grandi protagonisti della pittura moderna italiana del XIII secolo, la cui fama viene presto offuscata dal suo migliore allievo: Giotto. Ma al pittore fiorentino si devono opere celebri, prima fra tutte il Crocifisso della Basilica di Santa Croce a Firenze.

programme.title: Il giorno e la storia
programme.desc: Persone, eventi e ricorrenze del 23 novembre 2026.

programme.title: Storia POP
programme.desc: Sette voci, sette angoli visuali diversi, cento storie: Storia Pop è una narrazione corale, tutta al femminile, che svela pagine inedite della Storia. Dall'antica Grecia alla storia della TV, con linguaggio immediato e diretto, le sette divulgatrici costruiscono un mosaico di racconti che guardano al passato ma parlano al presente.

programme.title: Sguardi in camera
programme.desc: Negli anni Quaranta, le cineprese in 8mm seguono i giovani al fronte e ne custodiscono i brevi ritorni: una licenza, un matrimonio in fretta, poi un'altra partenza. Nel 1943 il fascismo cade e il paese si divide, ma si continua a filmare tra bombardamenti, distruzioni e rari momenti di normalità. Fino alla liberazione, quando l'obiettivo ritrova il sorriso sui volti.

programme.desc: La vita e l'opera di Pier Paolo Pasolini, poeta, scrittore e regista tra i più controversi e lucidi intellettuali del Novecento. Il ritratto di un artista libero e provocatorio che ha raccontato senza compromessi le contraddizioni dell'Italia contemporanea.

Майка му умира при раждането, а бащата – беден собственик на магазин за копчета, изоставя бебето на прага на старчески дом. Там го намира Куини, която работи в дома и решава да го отгледа. Колкото Бенджамин расте на възраст, толкова се подмладява физически.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – One Concert to Rule Them All
Concertino pour trois pianos et cordes de Martinu
Qui a volé le Boléro de Ravel ?
Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen

Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Russian National Orchestra & Mikhail Pletnev
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Alerte enlèvement

Après l'avoir cherché tout l'après-midi, la famille se tourne vers les forces de l'ordre. Le lendemain matin, le plan "Alerte Enlèvement" est déclenché.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En septembre 1998, Michèle Gillet est retrouvée morte sur la terrasse de sa maison. Les enquêteurs désignent vite le coupable idéal : un certain Pascal Labarre, peintre en bâtiment. Le jeune homme est condamné à vingt ans de prison. En 2003, après une contre-enquête à rebondissements, il est acquitté.

programme.title: Non élucidé

La victime a été battue à mort. Qui Magalie a-t-elle croisé ce jour-là ? Quel mobile peut expliquer ce crime ?

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 5 septembre 2012, une voiture est retrouvée criblée de balles sur un parking de la Combe d'Ire, en Haute-Savoie. Un cycliste savoyard du nom de Sylvain Mollier, un touriste britannique du nom de Saad al-Hilli, ainsi que sa femme et sa belle-mère, ont été assassinés. Seules leurs deux fillettes ont survécu.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En décembre 2008, Stéphane Kameugne, 24 ans, étudiant à l'Ecole des Arts et Métiers de Châlons-en-Champagne, disparaît après la soirée de gala annuelle de remise des diplômes. Il est retrouvé noyé le 24 décembre. Une information est ouverte pour homicide volontaire, mais le crime n'a jamais été élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Mercredi 21 mars 2007, Christian Maréchal, chef de la police municipale de Chambourcy, est découvert gisant dans une mare de sang dans l'entrée de son pavillon. Il a reçu 18 coups de couteau. Qui pouvait en vouloir à ce père de famille respecté ? La police épuise toutes les pistes dont elle dispose.

programme.title: Alerte enlèvement
programme.desc: Le 23 avril 2015, Bérényss, 7 ans, joue devant son domicile à Sancy-le-Haut en Meurthe-et-Moselle. Vers 15 heures, sa mère s'inquiète de ne pas la voir. Elle réalise que sa fille a disparu. Très vite le vélo de l'enfant est retrouvé dans une ruelle voisine. Les gendarmes sont prévenus et, à 20H50, le parquet déclenche le dispositif "Alerte enlèvement".

programme.title: Alerte enlèvement
programme.desc: Le 18 octobre 2016, un homme s'introduit par la force dans un foyer associatif qui accueille des femmes battues et s'en prend à Vanessa, la mère de sa fille. Il la poursuit dans les couloirs de l'établissement et la frappe, avant de s'enfuir avec Djenah, leur bébé de quatre mois.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 13 octobre 1996, un membre de l'union sportive de l'arsenal maritime de Brest retrouve les corps de deux autres adhérents, criblés de balles. Il s'agit du technicien Paul Creton, et de François Picard, pharmacien chimiste. Depuis plus de quinze ans, les enquêteurs cherchent à résoudre cette affaire.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En 2011, le corps de Patricia Bouchon est découvert à Villematier, en Haute-Garonne. Cette mère de famille de 49 ans avait disparu depuis le 14 février. L'autopsie révèle qu'elle a été battue à mort et qu'elle n'a pas subi de violences sexuelles. Début 2014, son assassinat demeure non élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 2 novembre 2001, Eric Calers est raccompagné chez lui à Busnes, dans le Pas-de-Calais, par un collègue après sa journée de travail. Devant sa porte, il est abattu d'une balle dans le dos. Qui pouvait en vouloir à cet homme sans histoires ? Retour sur une affaire qui demeure, à ce jour, non élucidée.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En novembre 2008, Jacques Heusèle, un assureur d'Arras de 59 ans, disparait. Deux mois plus tard, son cadavre est repêché dans une rivière belge. Depuis 2010, une information pour chantage, vol, assassinat est ouverte par le parquet de Béthune. Mais, pour l'instant, le mystère reste entier.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le lundi 29 janvier 2001, Christian Poucet, syndicaliste engagé dans la défense des petits commerçants et homme d'affaires de 44 ans, arrive dans les locaux de l'une de ses sociétés à Baillargues, dans l'Hérault. Quelques minutes plus tard, deux hommes cagoulés entrent et l'abattent.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Un jeune touriste belge, Xavier Baligant, est retrouvé tué de plusieurs coups de feu sur l'autoroute A31 non loin de Nancy, en juillet 2011, sur une aire de repos. Son assassinat ressemblant à une véritable exécution, plusieurs questions se posent. Avait-il des ennemis qui auraient pu lui en vouloir ? S'est-il arrêté par hasard ?

programme.desc: Han një djalosh i pashëm dhe karizmatik është i mbushur me kujtime të dhimbshme dhe tragjedi brenda familjes. Pas kthimit nga SHBA, ai i kushton jetën babait dhe motrave të cilat vuajnë nga probleme fiziologjike, si pasojë tragjike e traumave të tyre të fëmijërisë dhe historisë familjare. I izoluar nga çdo aktivitet shoqëror rastesisht takon Incin dhe menjëherë bie në dashuri me të. Për herë të parë në jetën e tij, do të kërkojë lumturinë!

programme.title: Galatasaray - Aston Villa - UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.title: Sot

Rubrika të përjavshme dhe ditore. Ekipi i emisionit është i pranishëm çdo ditë në terren. Përmes rubrikës ”Hajt Pak”, programi është shndërruar në zërin e vërtetë të qytetarëve.

programme.title: Te Linda
programme.desc: Kuzhina më e popullarizuar televizive në Kosovë vjen në ekranin e Kohavisionit çdo ditë pune. Receta nga më të ndryshme me plot shije dhe delikatesë e të realizuara me shumë përkushtim edhe për nga ana vizuale, është pa dyshim adresa e duhur për t’u njohur me shijet e reja, por edhe ato tradicionale.

Histori suksesi, personazhe interesante dhe rrëfime në studio janë pjesë e emisionit, i cili sjell çdo javë rubrikën e popullarizuar ”Shqiptarët nëpër botë”.

programme.title: Express

Magazina e pasdites në KTV është adresë për tema nga fusha të ndryshme, që nga zhvillimet politike e sociale, e deri te lajmet nga kultura, showbizi dhe sporti.

programme.title: Lajmet e mbrëmjes
programme.desc: Lajmet e Mbrëmjes, çdo mbrëmje nga ora 19:00, janë edicioni kryesor dhe më i besueshëm i lajmeve në Kosovë. Një grup gazetarësh e redaktorësh sjellin të gjitha lajmet nga politika deri te kultura, nga secili skaj i Kosovës. Në edicionin qendror të lajmeve ndër vite janë ekspozuar skandalet më të mëdha, keqpërdorimet enorme, gëzimet, festat, por edhe fatkeqësitë e popullit të Kosovës.

programme.title: Kid-E-Cats

programme.title: The Game Catchers

programme.title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
programme.desc: Emily Elizabeth, Clifford, Bailey, and Tucker go on a pretend pirate adventure around Birdwell Island in search of treasure; when Tucker loses his squeaky toy, it's up to Emily Elizabeth and Clifford to find that doggy toy before bedtime.

programme.title: Donkey Hodie
programme.desc: Cousin Hodie's pet rock Dotto goes missing; Donkey hosts a special tea party but forgets her pals' favorite teas and treats.

programme.title: Gabby's Farm
programme.desc: Gabby is at a farm that grows mushrooms; she counts five big mushrooms as they harvest them for the farmer's market.

programme.title: Jasmine & Jambo
programme.desc: When Jambo and Jasmine get into a disagreement, Jasmine and their friends imitate Jambo's gestures; this gives Jambo an idea: if they sing a song as if they were imitating the person in front of them, they can do a canon in which they can all sing.

programme.title: Tiny and Tall
programme.desc: Tiny and Tall are excited to pick lots of zazzy fruit; Tall is stressed when the differently sized fruits get mixed up; they use their sorting skills to set things straight.

programme.title: The Brilliant World of Tom Gates
programme.desc: Tom's homework is late again, so Leroy suggests they do their homework together; Tom is only interested in learning Leroy's magic trick, and soon they try to employ magic to get out of detention.

programme.title: Isadora Moon
programme.desc: Isadora and her father, transformed into fish, go underwater to recover Delphina's crown; a cheeky turtle takes it.

programme.title: Wacky Number Songs
programme.desc: Ava learns how to count to really high numbers by skip counting.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: The Mighty Twins join the Mighty Pups to save a giant chicken and the town; the Mighty Pups have to stop Harold Humdinger before he puts Adventure Bay in a deep freeze so he can become mayor.

programme.title: TVOkids Hosted Breaks
programme.desc: Let's figure out what the pattern is!

programme.title: Wordsville
programme.desc: When reporter read's notebook with the word "serious" emblazoned on the front goes missing, so does the word "serious"; word detectives Gabby and Sly call Baker Graham and Artist Clay to solve this word mystery.

programme.title: Messy Goes to OKIDO
programme.desc: Everyone in Okido is feeling tired; Messy tries to help by adding extra super beans to Farmer Fuddle's new recipe, but now everyone has far too much energy!

programme.title: Blynk & Aazoo
programme.desc: A young inquirer, Yowisa, asks Blynk and Aazoo why her hair is different from her best friend's; the intergalactic science expert, Eugenia, discovers what hair is made of, how it gets its color and texture, and how animal fur is no different.

programme.title: Odd Squad
programme.desc: Olive and Otto, agents with the Odd Squad, investigate unusual happenings in their town.

programme.title: Interstellar Ella
programme.desc: Madhu is on a mission to find rubies for Madwhy, but Ella and Slippy keep playing and getting distracted. Madhu tries being assertive but goes too far and becomes bossy. programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger the Tricarrotops explores the world of the crunchiest era, going on adventures throughout the colorful Vegesaur Valley.

programme.title: Urban Tails
programme.desc: Hypa Hyena, the cool spotted hyena from sub-Saharan Africa, invites everyone to laugh along with her as she teaches cool hyena facts on her banging track, Hyena Time.

programme.title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
programme.desc: The Spotty Whizzer zips around the sky erratically, making it hard for B.O.T. to take a photo or record sound. When more Spotty Whizzer plants grow and take off like rockets, B.O.T. must move quickly to complete this mission.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: When JoJo and Gran Gran visit the beach, JoJo is surprised to find the sea is not there anymore; Gran Gran explains that the sea is just further away as the tide is out, making it the perfect time to go beachcombing.

programme.title: Create
programme.desc: An educational program that shares fun arts and crafts ideas that can be tried out at home; from food art, to hairstyles, to origami and paper planes.

programme.title: Kid-E-Cats
programme.desc: One day, Cookie, Candy and Pudding visit Grandma for afternoon tea; she offers them honey, a treat that the kittens have never tried before; Grandma teaches the kittens that honey is made by bees.

programme.title: Woolly Woolly
programme.desc: Lila and Marco, two creative children, bring to life a quintet of knitted gnomes with whimsical journeys in a cozy universe made of wool.

programme.title: Pip and Posy
programme.desc: Pip and Posy try to stay up late for a midnight snack.

programme.title: Ladybird and Bee
programme.desc: After a storm in Wild Meadow, Ladybird and Bee go to meet some new neighbors.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Odo and Doodle teach Reggie the fox how to fly.

programme.title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
programme.desc: It's the Animal Star Rangers against the evil Space Weasel in an epic game of hide-and-seek to save the galaxy; when Clifford's size makes playing hide-and-seek difficult, Emily Elizabeth must find a creative way to help him.

programme.title: Now You Know
programme.desc: Howie and Baboo dig in the dirt and shake a paw before wondering why dogs sniff everything.

programme.title: Wacky Media Songs

programme.title: Burps, Butts and Bones
programme.desc: A medical skeleton named Bones answers body-related questions that are sent in by real-life children, while a squad of kid reporters known as the B Team find out more about the topic.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star; but when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring; Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom; but when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o niezwykłych miejscach w Polsce. W tym odcinku: dziennikarski Żoliborz.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: Muzyczne naj
programme.desc: W tym odcinku pojawiają się utwory, muzyka i historia dokonań scenicznych Edyty Geppert.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: W światłach zorzy
programme.desc: Na dalekiej północy, w Laponii, czas płynie inaczej. Surowe warunki, które zmuszają mieszkańców do korzystania z psich zaprzęgów, wydają się Monice i Maćkowi spełnieniem ich marzeń. Film przedstawia kilka dni z życia polskiej rodziny, która w 2017 roku zdecydowała się zamieszkać w jednym z najzimniejszych miejsc na Ziemi.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Rączka gotuje
programme.desc: Remigiusz Rączka kontynuuje jesienną rajzę po Śląsku, żeby sprawdzić, jak zmienia się nasz region. Tym razem odwiedza teren po byłej kopalni Rozbark w Bytomiu. W Izbie Tradycji gotuje wspólnie z młodzieżą - uczestnikami konkursu "TransformujeMY Śląskie. Młodzi dla młodych", a w menu kapuśniak na gęsinie i torcik cwibakowy.

programme.title: Na tropach historii
programme.desc: Cykl przybliżający historię województwa świętokrzyskiego. Opisując zrywy narodowe, klęski, wielkie i małe zwycięstwa, najnowsze odkrycia archeologiczne i geologiczne. Podążamy śladami, które pozostawiła historia.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kontynuacja popularnego serialu komediowego o tematyce obyczajowej. Serial opowiada o perypetiach młodej Amerykanki, która na skutek splotu różnych okoliczności życiowych osiedla się w małej, podlaskiej wsi Wilkowyje.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Aleksander Brückner wybitny slawista, badacz języka i kultury polskiej urodził się 29 stycznia 1856 roku w Tarnopolu. Kształcił się w Lipsku, Berlinie i Wiedniu. W wieku 25 lat rozpoczął współpracę z katedrą języków i literatur słowiańskich.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Kiedy Adam ponownie powraca do domu Pyrków pod wpływem środków odurzających i pozbawia domowników zapasów na śniadanie, Joanna z trudem panuje nad wzburzeniem. Lokator nie traci jednak rezonu i wkrótce prosi Huberta o kolejną pożyczkę.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W klasie Zosi Nocul jest nowa uczennica Julka, dziewczynki zaprzyjaźniają się. Rodzina Julki przeprowadziła się do Sandomierza, chroni ich policja. Ojciec jest świadkiem koronnym w procesie mafii. W szkole trwają poszukiwania Zosi i Julki.

programme.title: Profesor Michałowski. Droga do Faras
programme.desc: Historia najwybitniejszego polskiego archeologa, prof. Kazimierza Michałowskiego i jego największego odkrycia w Faras. Bez jego determinacji i pasji nie byłoby polskiej archeologii z jej międzynarodowymi sukcesami i pozycją, jaką ma dziś.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Bruno udaje przed dziewczyną, że jest piłkarzem, chociaż nie potrafi grać. Za to Zuza staje się cleanfluencerką, która nie potrafi sprzątać, a Maja wspomina przygody z mamą, w które nikt nie chce jej uwierzyć.

programme.title: Tylko jeden skecz
programme.desc: Pogram montażowy, w którym prezentujemy znane i lubiane skecze. W programie "Czeska piosenka" w wykonaniu Kabaretu Ani Mru Mru.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: Polscy szpiedzy
programme.desc: Gościem programu jest były oficer wywiadu wojskowego Maciej Moryc. W rozmowie opowiada o swojej służbie podczas misji w Afganistanie, specyfice pracy wywiadowczej w strefie działań wojennych oraz wyzwaniach, z jakimi mierzyli się polscy oficerowie. Jak zdobywa się informacje w kraju ogarniętym konfliktem i jak wygląda praca wywiadu na współczesnym polu walki?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Kiedy Adam ponownie powraca do domu Pyrków pod wpływem środków odurzających i pozbawia domowników zapasów na śniadanie, Joanna z trudem panuje nad wzburzeniem. Lokator nie traci jednak rezonu i wkrótce prosi Huberta o kolejną pożyczkę.

programme.title: Przyrodnik na tropie
programme.desc: Dawno temu wierzono, że dąb był pierwszym drzewem na świecie. Wierzono, że tylko błyskawica z nieba była w stanie go pokonać. Był drzewem świętym, królewskim.

programme.title: Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Karol Okrasa w miejscowości Nowe Radzikowo w pobliżu Czerwińska nad Wisłą spotyka się z paniami z Koła Gospodyń Wiejskich, które odtwarzają dawne przepisy. Jedną z takich ciekawych potraw są placki z buraka cukrowego.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Irena Karczewska z domu Weisberg opowiada historię swojej rodziny, jej losów w trakcie wojny i osób, które pomogły jej w tym trudnym czasie.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Do Berlina wyrusza łączniczka podziemnej organizacji z bardzo ważnymi informacjami. Ma je przekazać agentce - szwedzkiej aktorce Christin Kield. W rzeczywistości Christin jest agentką podwójną.

programme.title: Vito odkrywa Polskę
programme.desc: Tym razem Vito odwiedził pradawną krainę, czyli Jurę Krakowsko - Częstochowską. Wspinał się na wapienne skały w Rzędkowicach, odwiedził swojego rodaka w pizzerii i dowiedział się, czemu budowano zamki obronne na słynnym szlaku Orlich Gniazd.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Celina kontynuuje działania w sprawie Justina, co spotyka się z wyraźnym niezadowoleniem ze strony Łukasza. Ostatecznie Brońska przekazuje zgromadzone dowody komisarzowi Majakowi, zwracając się do funkcjonariusza z prośbą o interwencję.

programme.title: Dziewczyna ze zdjęcia
programme.desc: W 2022 r. IPN z okazji 8 marca upublicznił kilka zdjęć archiwalnych przedstawiających Polki. Wśród nich uwagę przykuwała fotografia młodej dziewczyny w mundurze wojskowymi i furażerce. To jedno z 40 milionów zdjęć znajdujących się w IPN.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane. Prowadzący przenoszą widza do minionych epok, uwzględniając dokonania współczesnych konserwatorów, historyków.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Shipwrecks Taiwan:4
programme.desc: 全片探訪了八個台灣的沈船地點，它們曾經是縱橫海上的鋼鐵巨人，因為不同原因而長眠海底，現在成為了眾多海洋生物最溫暖的家。本節目由具備將近30年節目製作與豐富水下攝影經驗的李景白擔任導演，他所帶領的製作團隊包括配樂、剪輯也都是金獎等級的成員，並由藝人王陽明擔任旁白以及潛水引路者。

programme.title: Viva La Vita:4
programme.desc: 《我在工場拍拍手》節目，走訪全台16個工「場」，包括：飛機維修廠、遊艇製造廠、酪農場、螺絲廠、麵包廠、伐木場、米酒廠、玻璃工廠、家具工廠等等，彰顯產品製造的細節美學，以及職人們追求精進的態度，將生硬的產業題材提煉出溫柔的故事。

programme.title: Satoyama-Wild Neighbors:1
programme.desc: 《Satoyama: Wild Neighbors》一共三集，深入貢寮、南投與苗栗的淺山環境，透過石虎、食蟹?、穿山甲、台灣角金龜等明星物種的生命故事，記錄人與自然在農村、森林與水田間交織而成的生態網絡，也看見居民、研究者與保育團隊如何攜手守護土地，尋找人與自然共生的可能。

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon.

programme.title: Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Bill Williamson (Bill Robinson), a struggling performer, meets a beautiful vocalist named Selina Rogers (Lena Horne). Bill promises her that they will be together after he becomes a success. However, he and Selina both skyrocket to fame and lose contact. Fortunately, Bill just might get one more chance to woo Selina at a huge musical stage show. Popular entertainers of the 1940s, including Fats Waller and Cab Calloway, perform as themselves in the film.

programme.title: A Song Is Born
programme.desc: A group of music professors, including Frisbee (Danny Kaye) and Magenbruch (Benny Goodman), are writing an encyclopedia of music. A pair of window washers introduces the duo to a pioneering musical form called jazz. Frisbee and Magenbruch start going to nightclubs to hear the new sound and become involved with club singer Honey Swanson (Virginia Mayo), who is running from police because they want her to inform on her gangster boyfriend, Tony Crow (Steve Cochran).

programme.title: Reveille With Beverly
programme.desc: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

programme.title: Hollywood Hotel
programme.desc: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

programme.title: Ship Ahoy
programme.desc: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

programme.title: Du Barry Was a Lady
programme.desc: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Sea
programme.desc: An old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) has not caught anything in 84 days. Despite the devotion of the young boy (Felipe Pazos) who brings him coffee and food, the fisherman fears he has become perpetually unlucky. On his 85th day of fishing, the old man catches a small fish and decides to keep fishing. When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: When spoiled Harvey Cheyne (Freddie Bartholomew) is suspended from boarding school, his businessman father (Melvyn Douglas) takes him to Europe on a business trip. When the rebellious lad falls overboard from the steamship, he is saved from death by humble fisherman Manuel Fidello (Spencer Tracy) and forced by the captain of the fishing schooner (Lionel Barrymore) to become a low-ranking member of the ship's crew alongside the captain's own son (Mickey Rooney).

programme.title: Malaya
programme.desc: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

programme.title: Northwest Passage
programme.desc: An epic Western, about Major Robert Rogers, the tough frontiersman who led a grueling expedition to Canada in 1759 to punish a fearsome Indian tribe and seek a northwest passage to the Pacific. Langdon Towne and Hunk Marriner joined the Rangers at the Indian village, but when they head on to Fort Wentworth, they find the place deserted.

programme.title: Plymouth Adventure
programme.desc: Stubborn Capt. Christopher Jones (Spencer Tracy) pilots the historically famous Mayflower on its maiden voyage across the storm-swept Atlantic. Thankfully, a resourceful carpenter (Van Johnson) keeps the weather damage in check. Also among the passengers is Dorothy (Gene Tierney), the wife of the religiously zealous leader of the pilgrims. Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

programme.title: Lord Jeff
programme.desc: In London, orphan Geoff Bramer (Freddie Bartholomew) helps thieves Doris (Gale Sondergaard) and Jim (George Zucco) with a racket stealing from jewelry stores. Once apprehended, Geoff is sent to a mariner's academy run by kindly headmaster Capt. Briggs (Charles Coburn) that houses orphaned boys. Geoff resists the school's discipline and runs away, but school leader Terry O'Mulvaney (Mickey Rooney) brings him back, then refuses to tell on him -- prompting Geoff to reconsider his attitude.

programme.title: Sweethearts
programme.desc: Happily married New York City stage actors Ernest Lane (Nelson Eddy) and Gwen Marlowe (Jeanette MacDonald) are stars of a successful Broadway production. However, when the couple is wooed by Hollywood, the team behind the play, including theater producer Felix Lehman (Frank Morgan), launches a scheme to prevent their move to the West Coast. While the deception works, it also causes the charming pair to split. Can Ernest and Gwen see through the lies and rekindle their love?

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Crotchety miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Reginald Owen) hates Christmas and mistreats his long-suffering employee, devoted family man Bob Cratchit (Gene Lockhart). But a visit from the ghost of his former business partner Jacob Marley (Leo G. Carroll) and three Christmas spirits (Lionel Braham, Ann Rutherford, D'Arcy Corrigan) might convince him to change his ways and become more kindhearted. This adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic became a holiday staple for decades.

programme.title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
programme.desc: Young schoolteacher Charles Edward Chipping (Robert Donat) imposes strict discipline on his young charges at a Victorian-era English public school, becoming a fearsome presence on the campus grounds. But the love of spirited young suffragette Katherine Ellis (Greer Garson) brings the Latin instructor out of his shell and makes him a beloved campus institution into the 20th century and through the shattering violence of World War I. The film is based on the best-selling novel by James Hilton.

programme.title: Andy Hardy Gets Spring Fever
programme.desc: In the small town of Carvel, Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone) learns from a chemist and promoter that a plot of land always considered worthless is actually rich in bauxite, a mineral used to make aluminum. After verifying the claim, the judge urges his friends and neighbors to invest in the land with him. Meanwhile, the judge's teenage son, Andy (Mickey Rooney), falls for a new teacher after getting dumped by his girlfriend. Both the judge and Andy learn that things aren't what they seem.

programme.title: A Yank at Eton
programme.desc: Dismayed when his mother marries Englishman Roger Carlton (Ian Hunter), teenager Tim Dennis (Mickey Rooney) chafes at leaving America and his college football dreams to move to England. His mother convinces Tim to try Eton College for six months, but once there he clashes with the traditions of the conservative students -- who are led by Roger's son, school head boy Peter (Freddie Bartholomew). When Tim's girlfriend shows an interest in Peter, Tim's response nearly causes disaster.

programme.title: National Velvet

However, a last-minute problem arises with the jockey and an unexpected rider must step in as a replacement.

programme.title: Zwischen Tüll und Tränen
programme.desc: Eine jede Braut möchte an ihrem Hochzeitstag im perfekten Kleid erscheinen. Die Bandbreite an Modellen überfordert die angehenden Bräute jedoch oft und schnell kann es dann auch mal emotional werden – schließlich ist die Entscheidung eine sehr besondere. Bei der Suche nach dem Traumkleid helfen die routinierten Brautmodenexperten der Doku-Soap.

programme.title: First Dates – Ein Tisch für zwei
programme.desc: Starkoch Trettl („The Taste“-Juror von 2016 bis 2018) begrüßt die einsamen Herzen, die vorab anhand von Vorlieben und Abneigungen ausgewählt wurden, dann zieht er sich zurück und beobachtet, ob sich die Paare zwischen Salat und Dessert näherkommen. Nach dem Menü stellt sich die Frage: Gibt es ein weiteres Date?

programme.title: Das perfekte Dinner
programme.desc: May-Britt (25) aus Mönchengladbach serviert heute ein Drei-Gänge-Menü. Motto: Mediterraner Sommer Vorspeise: Sommerliches Lachstatar mit knusprigem Parmesanchip Hauptspeise: Rinderfilet auf sommerlich-süß geschmorten Tomaten, Kartoffel-Mille-feuille, abgerundet mit einer Zitronensoße Nachspeise: Zitronen-Panna-cotta, begleitet von warmen Mandelstreuseln, dazu Himbeercoulis (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lege kommt auf den Geschmack
programme.desc: Auch wenn’s draußen kalt ist: Eis geht immer! Für den Genuss tourt der Tüftler zur einzigen Eis-Uni der Welt – nach Bologna. In Holland lässt er sich zeigen, wie man knusprige Waffeln macht, und in einer Hamburger Manufaktur, wie veganes Eis cremig wird.

programme.title: Goodbye Deutschland! Die Auswanderer
programme.desc: Jennifer Schmidt riskiert für die Liebe einen Neuanfang in Paris, doch ein Unfall bedroht ihre Pläne.

programme.title: vox nachrichten
programme.desc: Aktuelle Berichterstattung über die wichtigsten Nachrichten des Tages.

programme.title: Medical Detectives – Geheimnisse der Gerichtsmedizin
programme.desc: Joann Notheis beginnt eine Affäre mit dem Elektriker Jim Williams, dessen Frau Sharon wenig später bei einem Verkehrsunfall stirbt. Zwei Monate darauf verschwindet Joanns Mann Walter spurlos. Joann reicht die Scheidung ein und heiratet Jim. Als sich herausstellt, dass Sharons Unfall geplant war, betrachtet die Polizei Jim Williams als Hauptverdächtigen und kombiniert, dass auch Walters Verschwinde

programme.title: 給香港的情書 貳 第19集 -生活藝術家(⺠俗音樂、藝術修行、紋身師)
programme.desc: Lester兼具民俗音樂及紋身創作的多重身份。他曾任獨立樂隊「觸執毛」的吉他手，並在設計領域追求美學。多年來，他在藝術界的努力使他成為專業創作者，並深受素食和修佛理念的啟發，使創作更具意義。近年，他專注於民俗音樂的研究，透過樂器及表演形式深化自我成長，並以此組建樂隊「I is one」，曾在Clockenflap表演，結合修行與哲理元素。此外，他創立了素食餐廳「余地」，寓意生活中的選擇，倡導以簡單方式將素食與生活結合，Lester相信，藝術的價值在於實踐，而非高深的理論，展現了他對藝術和生活的熱誠。

programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地。

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch trying to take down a buck with his new Thompson Center Muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird
programme.desc: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target bucks.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Raven Food Plots and Summer Work Part 2
programme.desc: Randy is still at the Raven finishing up the Big Tine plots and hanging a new set of stands in hopes of killing a buck he has his eye on come fall.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2
programme.desc: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Rifle Camp At The Raven
programme.desc: Randy and the crew are finishing up the last of the food plots on the Raven and then the Tikka rifles come out as we fast forward to rifle camp at the Raven. Nate is able to catch up with a dandy of a buck and Randy's dad Travis also known as “Big Haus” is able to catch up with a fine Missouri buck of his own.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Summer Time Borderline And Clover Plot Maintenance
programme.desc: Join in as Randy and Cody are hard at work on the Raven Planting some Big Tine borderline on one of their favorite plots on the farm. Then learn all about their summer time clover plot maintenance routine.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Summer Time Work On The Raven
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven in Missouri trying to take advantage of some dry weather and get some Big Tine borderline planted and check off a long list of other summer time prep work as opening day of deer season will be here before we know it.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.sub-title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors - "Starbrite Double Feature 2 (The Collective)
programme.desc: Capt. Blair takes head of Starbrite, Greor Dornau out of Cape Canaveral for a day of fishing and ends the show fishing with Dr. Todd Osborne of the Indian River Clam restoration project all during the Starbrite Seasafe Collective weekend in an effort to support the project.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: It's that time of the year again. Time to tag some redfish for the FL STAR tournament by CCA. Like always, Leiza and Blair explain the many ways to win big while catching some big reds.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out to the very first spot we ever filmed a BWO show, with the first guide ever on BWO Capt. John Beach. This time they're catching sheepshead, hopefully nobody gets bit this time.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.sub-title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors - "Father's Day Bucket List
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads to the great state of Alaska to bring you a sight never seen before on this show, Capt. Blair in close-toed shoes. He catches some petty cool fish too, thanks to Capt. Geoff Peck at Baranof Fishing Excursions.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Heavy hearts find comfort in cherished memories as the Local Knowledge crew mourns the loss of one of the greatest members of the fishing industry. Looking back on several of our episodes with our dear friend Dave Salazar, we celebrate the life of this amazing fishermen, family man, and visionary behind the world renowned Casa Vieja Lodge.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The ability to overcome obstacles and challenging conditions can be key to success, but when fishing in Key West, cold temps are rarely the hurdle. For Rush and Ali, it's another day on the water where patience and a plan pays off with Cobia and Amberjack action that gets the rods bent after a cold weather spell in the Keys.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When it comes to fishing in Key West, you can often get a lot done in a little bit of time. After an early check in to Ocean's Edge Resort and a mid day departure from then dock, Ali looks to Rush to put him on an afternoon bite of tuna and bottom fish that few other places can offer. If Rush is going to deliver, he will need to make a plan and stick to it to make the best use of this limited time.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: For Ali and Rush, one of the best aspects of fishing is being able to share experiences on the water with interesting people. On this episode we invite luxury watch enthusiast Eric Rivera - AKA "Watch Eric" to the Florida Keys to target Permit and Amberjack in the Gulf.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Coast Guard helicopter pilot Shay Williams recounts his career flying countless search and rescue missions.

programme.title: Top Weather News, Regional Forecasts, Live Severe Coverage, and Local Weather

programme.desc: En compagnie de l'experte des trous noirs Julie Hlavacek-Larrondo, l'expert des étoiles massives Laurent Drissen, et le communicateur scientifique Pierre Chastenay, Pierre-Yves découvre les objets étranges qui peuplent l'espace.

programme.title: Déchiffrer les villes
programme.desc: Métropole divisée, Berlin étonne et dérange par son esprit rebelle ; l'histoire et l'art sont partout : sur ses murs ou sous ses parcs bâtis à même les montagnes de débris laissés par la guerre.

programme.title: Le gros laboratoire
programme.desc: Est-ce que les ados ont le sens de l'observation? Est-il plus rapide d'écrire à la main, à l'ordinateur ou en texto? Et les talents inusités de nos cobayes.

programme.title: Le gros laboratoire
programme.desc: Nos ados sont-ils sensibles au biais d'ancrage ? Est-on plus efficaces que les fourmis ? Peut-on réprimer le sursaut ? Et à quel âge est-on vieux ou vieille ?

programme.title: Le gardien des ornithorynques
programme.desc: Employé dans un magasin de vélos, Pete Walsh, la cinquantaine, vit à Hobart, la capitale de la Tasmanie, dont il aime photographier les paysages sauvages. Mais sa vie bascule lorsqu'on lui diagnostique une lésion cérébrale. Trouvant du réconfort sur les rives de la rivière Derwent, il y porte bientôt secours à une femelle ornithorynque piégée dans du plastique.

programme.title: Dezoom, les plaies de notre terre
programme.desc: La centrale solaire de Gemasolar est unique en son genre; grâce à une technologie au sel fondu, elle est capable de produire de l'énergie jour et nuit; une qualité bienvenue à l'ère des énergies renouvelables.

programme.title: Prédateurs et proies, un équilibre fragile
programme.desc: L'ours polaire, le plus grand prédateur de la planète et spécialiste de la chasse à l'affût et excellent nageur, mène une vie faite de patience, de force et d'instinct; une mère et ses deux petits luttent pour survivre à l'été arctique.

programme.title: Génie vu du ciel

programme.desc: Une équipe spécialisée de designers et d'ingénieurs se bat contre le rude hiver arctique dans une course pour construire l'hôtel de glace ultime.

programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. programme.title: Aldo Morning Show

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argëtues me zn.Tefta e Katerina Trungu. Çdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi të gjitha ekonomike të Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si të ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: NEHIR
programme.desc: Ndertimi i nje dige do te shnderrohet ne nje vend ku dashuria ”permbyt” gjithçka. E gjitha filloi kur inxhinieri Nazim, nje ish i dashuruar i lenduar, me nje zemer te arte, njihet ”online” me gruan e endrrave te tij, Nehir. Ata shkruheshin per muaj te tere duke u lidhur shume me njeri-tjetrin. Ne panik nje dite ai zgjedh nje portret simpatik duke e genjyer ate dhe ajo u dashurua me ate genjeshter...

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argëtues me zn.Tefta e Katerina Trungu. Çdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi të gjitha ekonomike të Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si të ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Lule të vetmuara
programme.desc: Nje drame familjare dhe njerezore e disa vajzave jetime, te cilat do te mesojne si te perballojne jeten krejtesisht te vetmuara, te dashurojne, te bejne gabime, te rrezohen, te poshterohen, te ringrihen dhe te mbijetojne duke u mbeshtetur tek njera-tjetra! Nje histori mbijetese e disa vajzave te reja, ne nje bote te madhe, ku ato jane thjesht ”Lule” te vetmuara!

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Rudina

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Emisioni sjell një kombinim të lajmeve më të rëndësishme të ditës, analizave të aktualitetit, parashikimit të motit, informacioneve praktike, intervistave me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, rubrikave të argëtimit dhe muzikës. Me një atmosferë dinamike dhe pozitive, synon t’i informojë dhe argëtojë teleshikuesit, duke u ofruar energjinë e duhur për nisjen e ditës.

programme.title: Në shtëpinë tonë
programme.desc: Në Shtëpinë Tonë” është emisioni i paradites në Top Channel, një hapësirë e ngrohtë ku bashkohen historia, emocionet, informacioni dhe argëtimi. Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. Nje program i përditshëm informativ dhe i aktualitetit, i cili sjell në qendër të vëmendjes ngjarjet më të rëndësishme të ditës.

Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Champions League: Studio Champions
programme.desc: Ndeshjet e mëdha të Champions League do të shoqërohen nga një emision informativ ku do të analizohen ekipet më të mira dhe kompeticioni më i bukur në botë. Edi Manushi në moderim bashkë me ish-futbollistë dhe opinionistë do të sjellin çdo natë të Champions League analizën sportive para dhe pas ndeshjes. Pjesa e parë do të analizojë formacionet e skuadrave. Në pjesën e dytë pas ndeshjes do të komentojme rezultatin, paraqitjen e ekipeve si dhe do të shohim të gjithë golat.

programme.title: Inter-Stuttgart
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.desc: When Ricky makes a little money by selling his car, he forgets to tell his New York neighbors who drove out with him to Hollywood that he will buy their return train tickets.

programme.desc: On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.

programme.desc: Ricky Ricardo's new fame leads to an invitation to appear on a television interview program. The live interview is to take place in their home and Ricky's new agent wants them to move to a more posh apartment.

programme.desc: Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.

programme.desc: Ricky finds Lucy exhausted after a trying day with little Ricky and insists it is time their son started nursery school. Lucy's protests are overridden and Ricky takes young Ricky to nursery school, but the baby comes down with tonsillitis.
